about_the_game:
Step into a world of strategy, luck, and endless fun in this fast-paced multiplayer board game! Compete against friends or players from around the globe as you buy, upgrade, and dominate unique locations on the board. With quirky characters, hilarious interactions, and unexpected twists, every match is a fresh challenge.

Key Features:

🎲 Strategic Gameplay: Plan your moves carefully, invest wisely, and use your resources to outplay your opponents.

🌍 Unique Locations: Travel across vibrant, hand-crafted boards filled with exciting places to buy and conquer.

🤩 Hilarious Characters: Choose from a cast of funny, animated characters, each with their own personality and style.

🌐 Multiplayer Mayhem: Play with up to 6 players online, or invite your friends for a private match.

💡 Unpredictable Events: Experience thrilling surprises with every roll of the dice, from chance cards to game-changing bonuses.

Whether you’re in it for the laughs, the strategy, or the thrill of competition, this game is your ticket to hours of fun. Do you have what it takes to outsmart your rivals and claim victory? The board is waiting!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Haswell or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 550 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Built-in Mac sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Built-in Mac sound card

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300

  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or AMD Radeon R7 240

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
